item.title: India Advances Indigenous Semiconductor Design Ecosystem
item.description: India is strengthening its indigenous semiconductor design ecosystem through the Design Linked Incentive Scheme, fostering startups and academic innovation to boost self-reliance and competitiveness.

item.title: HKUST Partners to Accelerate Technology-Enabled Clinical Research
item.description: HKUST has signed strategic MoUs with three Zhejiang University hospitals to advance AI-driven medical research, clinical innovation and interdisciplinary technology-enabled healthcare education.

item.title: Vietnam: First Crypto Exchange to Boost Digital Asset Ecosystem
item.description: Vietnam’s launch of crypto exchange licensing aims to boost foreign investment, significantly enhance overall market transparency and strengthen effective regulatory oversight in the country’s digital asset sector.

item.title: Singapore: New Hardware Testbed Advances Quantum Capabilities
item.description: A quantum-innovation company has launched a new quantum hardware testbed, strengthening its national ecosystem, global collaborations and talent development in advanced quantum technologies.

item.title: Malaysia: Selangor Plans First Locally Designed Semiconductor Chip
item.description: Selangor is developing integrated IC design parks to enable Malaysia’s first locally designed semiconductor chip and strengthen domestic chip design capabilities across tech sectors.

item.title: Australia: Flinders Advances Smart Gold Recovery
item.description: Flinders University has developed a smart, recyclable polymer that selectively recovers gold from ore and electronic waste, offering a safer, cleaner, more sustainable alternative to toxic extraction methods.

item.title: The Philippines: Embracing a Digitally Empowered and Connected Future
item.description: President Marcos highlights new initiatives, including a national connectivity plan and satellite-based services, to expand fast, affordable and inclusive internet access across the Philippines.

item.title: Hong Kong: HKUST AI Enhances Severe Storm Predictability
item.description: Researchers at HKUST have developed a satellite-based AI system that can accurately forecast severe convective storms up to four hours in advance, improving short-term weather prediction and early warning.

item.title: Vietnam Rises as Southeast Asia’s AI Investment Hub
item.description: Vietnam is rapidly emerging as a regional AI hub, attracting global investment, expanding innovative start-ups, developing highly skilled talent and aiming to become a top-three R&D centre in Southeast Asia by 2030.

item.title: Singapore Strengthens Role in Global Memory Supply Chains
item.description: Singapore’s new advanced wafer fabrication facility strengthens its semiconductor memory and AI supply chain capabilities, creating high-value jobs, fostering innovation and deepening local industry partnerships.
